response.original_title: [Expert-Guide] How to Add a Guest to an Existing Crystal Cruise Booking
response.overview: To add a guest to an existing Crystal Cruises booking +1-866-254-7549, you must call Crystal Cruise Customer Service directly at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), or contact your original travel advisor, as passenger additions cannot be processed online +1-866-254-7549 or through the mobile app. Important Details to Keep in Mind Cabin & Ship Limits: Adding a guest depends on whether your current stateroom has the physical capacity +1-866-254-7549 (such as a sofa bed or Pullman) and whether the ship's overall lifeboat and occupancy limits allow another person. If Your Room is Full: If your current stateroom cannot fit an extra guest +1-866-254-7549, you may need to book a separate cabin and ask customer service to link the reservations.
